profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Chewy
profile.summary:
Quality-driven software developer with a demonstrated history of working in the automotive industry while delivering full-stack solutions that satisfy business requirements. I developed in Java (Spring Boot), SQL, and Javascript with multiple frameworks such as Angular and React through the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Working in various projects has helped me become flexible and goal-oriented in both team environment and autonomous settings. The constant innovation of technologies has also taught me to adapt to changes quickly.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
▪ Develop highly interactive web applications utilizing Spring framework (Java) and Oracle Database
▪ Enhance various web applications’ structures by integrating React, Angular, jQuery, and Bootstrap
▪ Monitor security scans for web services and remediate security vulnerabilities that were detected
▪ Prepare testing procedures according to the features implemented in web applications and fix bugs identified in testing
▪ Perform root cause analysis of production incidents and debug existing code

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned and developed a hotel accounting application utilizing JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, and CSS on Visual Studio.
• Supported experienced developers in reviewing product documentation and testing product features in multiple browsers.
• Documented test cases within the software by identifying defects and potential bugs.

positions.title: Marketing Assistant Intern
positions.description:
• Developed social media marketing campaign to expand visibility of the company on social media platforms.
• Collaborated with a financial advisor and brainstormed ideas that effectively drive product awareness.
• Identified potential sales and marketing opportunities to the leadership team.

educations.schoolName: University of Georgia - Terry College of Business
educations.fieldOfStudy: Management Information Systems with a minor in Statistics
